farm_pond.label: new farm ponds
farm_pond.note: 10 new farm ponds in Basantrai tehsil show no average change in cropping intensity around them that can be told apart from zero: +4.3 points (95% range −5.8 to +15.9). 2 show a likely gain or an early sign of one and 1 a loss, against about 1 each expected by chance. Rabi and summer cropping changed by +4.2 points of the zones' cropland. In 2023-24 and 2024-25, with only the micro-watersheds left as comparison, the 13 ponds with data in those years show +2.2 points (an early sign).

farm_pond.label: new farm ponds
farm_pond.note: 23 new farm ponds in Boarijor tehsil show no average change in cropping intensity around them that can be told apart from zero: +0.6 points (95% range −4.8 to +6.0). 6 show a likely gain or an early sign of one and 3 a loss, against about 2 each expected by chance. Rabi and summer cropping changed by +2.9 points of the zones' cropland. In 2023-24 and 2024-25, with only the micro-watersheds left as comparison, the 40 ponds with data in those years show −6.6 points (an early sign).

headwater_pond.label: new headwater ponds / check dams
headwater_pond.note: 9 new headwater ponds / check dams in Boarijor tehsil can be assessed so far: on average +4.7 points of cropping intensity in their zones of influence compared with the prediction had they not been built. Too few to rely on.
